recipes.name: Beef Suya
recipes.description: Peanut-spice rubbed open-fire beef skewers - Nigeria's night king.

steps.instruction: Oil meat; press yaji generously; rest 1h.
Charcoal grill hot ~4 min/side.
Re-yaji off fire; onion-tomato crown.

recipes.name: Egusi Soup with Beef
recipes.description: Melon-seed thickened soup with beef - swallow's best friend.

ingredients.name: Red palm oil & onions & pepper blend

steps.instruction: Cook beef till tender with pepper/onion.
Palm oil; egusi fry till curdled gold.
Broth in; simmer 20; greens last.

videos.videoTitle: THE BEST NIGERIAN EGUSI SOUP RECIPE | EGUSI SOUP RECIPE : SISI JEMIMAH

recipes.name: Efo Riro with Beef
recipes.description: 'Stirred spinach' Yoruba stew loaded with beef and peppers.

ingredients.name: Red pepper-onion blend fried till paste

steps.instruction: Fry pepper blend in palm oil till oil rises.
Iru + seasoned beef broth.
Spinach fold-through 5 min only.

videos.videoTitle: HOW TO MAKE EFO RIRO: UPDATED EFO RIRO RECIPE | SISI JEMIMAH

recipes.name: Nigerian Beef Pepper Soup
recipes.description: Clear fiery herb-spiced broth - the ultimate Nigerian pick-me-up.

steps.instruction: Boil beef with onion till tender.
Spices + bonnet; simmer 20 min watery-clear.
Scent leaf wilt; serve steaming.

videos.videoTitle: PEPPER SOUP RECIPE | HOW TO MAKE COW MEAT/ BEEF PEPPER SOUP

recipes.name: Ofada Rice
recipes.description: Fragrant local rice with spicy ayamase stew

steps.instruction: Wash ofada rice and parboil until half-cooked.
Fry blended pepper mix in palm oil with locust beans.
Add assorted beef and cook until tender.
Stir in parboiled rice and simmer until done.

videos.videoTitle: How To Cook Ofada Rice | Ofada rice recipe | The Online Cook

recipes.name: Kilishi
recipes.description: Thin dried spiced beef jerky from northern Nigeria

steps.instruction: Slice beef paper-thin across the grain.
Blend groundnut paste with spices into a marinade.
Coat beef strips evenly and sun-dry for 4 hours.
Grill over low charcoal until crispy.

recipes.name: Abacha
recipes.description: African salad made from dried shredded cassava

steps.instruction: Soak abacha shreds in warm water until softened.
Boil beef and pomo until tender, slice thinly.
Mix palm oil with potash to thicken.
Combine abacha, meats, oil mix, crayfish, and utazi.

recipes.name: Banga Soup
recipes.description: Rich palm fruit soup with spices from the Niger Delta

steps.instruction: Boil beef with onion until tender.
Add banga concentrate and bring to a boil.
Add beletete, crayfish, and pepper.
Simmer for 10 minutes until oil floats.

recipes.name: Efirin Rice
recipes.description: Jollof-style rice cooked with scent leaf and beef

steps.instruction: Fry beef strips with onion until browned.
Add tomato blend and cook down.
Stir in washed rice and water to cover.
Cook until rice is done, fold in scent leaves at end.

recipes.name: Beef Pepper Soup
recipes.description: Aromatic spicy beef broth with uziza leaves

steps.instruction: Boil beef with onion and pepper soup spice.
Add scotch bonnet and cook until beef is tender.
Stir in uziza leaves.
Simmer 5 more minutes and serve hot.

recipes.name: Suya Kebab
recipes.description: Spiced grilled beef skewers with yaji spice

steps.instruction: Slice beef thinly against the grain.
Coat generously with yaji spice and groundnut powder.
Thread onto skewers and rest for 30 minutes.
Grill over hot coals until charred and cooked.

recipes.name: Kundi Beef
recipes.description: Dried spiced beef from Hausa tradition

steps.instruction: Slice beef thin and pound lightly.
Marinate with yaji spice, ginger, garlic, and lemon.
Sun-dry for 6 hours or until leathery.
Grill or smoke briefly before serving.

recipes.name: Kilishi Rolls
recipes.description: Rolled beef kilishi with groundnut filling

steps.instruction: Pound beef paper thin.
Mix groundnut paste with yaji spice and honey.
Spread filling on beef and roll tightly.
Dry in sun or low oven until firm.

recipes.name: Dindin Rice
recipes.description: Crispy fried rice with beef from southwestern Nigeria

steps.instruction: Heat oil in a wok and fry beef strips.
Scramble egg and push to the side.
Add vegetables and stir-fry briefly.
Add rice and soy sauce, toss until heated through.

recipes.name: Uyoyo
recipes.description: Yam porridge with beef and palm oil

steps.instruction: Boil beef until tender.
Add cubed yam to the pot with water.
Cook until yam is soft, mash slightly.
Add palm oil, crayfish, pepper, beef, and greens.

recipes.name: Osu Beef Stew
recipes.description: Smoky beef stew from southeastern Nigeria

steps.instruction: Fry beef until browned and set aside.
Heat palm oil and fry tomato blend until reduced.
Add onion, thyme, pepper, and bouillon.
Return beef and simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Masa Rice Cakes
recipes.description: Fermented rice cakes fried until golden

steps.instruction: Mix rice flour with warm water and yeast, let ferment overnight.
Cook and shred beef, season lightly.
Heat masa pan and add oil to each mold.
Pour batter, add beef filling, cover and cook until set.

recipes.name: Palm Wine Stew
recipes.description: Beef stew cooked in palm wine from southeastern Nigeria

steps.instruction: Brown beef in palm oil with onion.
Add blended tomato and cook down.
Pour in palm wine and bring to a simmer.
Cook until sauce thickens, garnish with utazi.

recipes.name: Asun Peppered Goat
recipes.description: Spicy grilled peppered goat meat

steps.instruction: Boil goat meat until tender with thyme.
Cut into bite-sized pieces.
Grill over charcoal until slightly charred.
Toss with fried peppers and onion.

recipes.name: Goat Pepper Soup
recipes.description: Aromatic spicy goat meat broth

steps.instruction: Boil goat meat with pepper soup spice and onion.
Add scotch bonnet and cook until tender.
Stir in uziza leaves.
Simmer 5 minutes and serve.

recipes.name: Party Jollof Rice with Chicken
recipes.description: Smoky firewood-flavor jollof crowned with spiced fried chicken.

steps.instruction: Season-fry chicken; keep oil for stew.
Fry blended tomato-pepper till deep red reduced.
Rice fold; steam covered low till smoky-bottom done.

videos.videoTitle: How to Cook Nigeria Perfect Jollof Rice with Chicken

recipes.name: Obe Ata (Nigerian Chicken Stew)
recipes.description: Silky roasted-pepper chicken stew eaten with everything.

ingredients.name: Roasted red bell + scotch bonnet blend

steps.instruction: Boil-season chicken; reserve stock.
Fry pepper blend till oil crowns.
Chicken + stock; reduce 30 min glossy.

recipes.name: Ofada Rice & Ayamase Chicken
recipes.description: Local unpolished rice wrapped in leaves beside green-pepper ayamase chicken.

steps.instruction: Parboil ofada well; steam tender.
Green blend fried in palm oil till dark.
Chicken through sauce; wrap both in leaves.

recipes.name: Grilled Suya Chicken
recipes.description: Yaji-rubbed chicken thighs off the grill, suya-style.

steps.instruction: Rub yaji + oil; marinate 2h.
Grill 6-7 min per side charred.
Extra yaji dust + lime squeeze.

videos.videoTitle: HOW TO MAKE THE BEST CHICKEN SUYA!

recipes.name: Pepper Chicken
recipes.description: Fiery Nigerian-style chicken in spicy pepper sauce

steps.instruction: Season and boil chicken until half-cooked.
Blend scotch bonnets with onion and ginger.
Fry pepper blend in oil until reduced.
Add chicken and simmer until cooked through and saucy.

videos.videoTitle: HOW TO MAKE PEPPER CHICKEN AT HOME | BEST PEPPER CHICKEN FRY

recipes.name: Ayamase
recipes.description: Spicy green pepper stew with assorted meats and chicken

steps.instruction: Boil and season chicken until tender.
Blend green peppers and scotch bonnets.
Heat palm oil until very hot, add blended mix.
Cook down, add locust beans, onion, and chicken.

recipes.name: Chicken Yassa
recipes.description: Senegalese-influenced chicken stew with caramelized onions

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in mustard, lemon, and onion slices.
Grill or pan-fry chicken until golden.
Caramelize sliced onions in oil until golden.
Add chicken back with a little water and simmer.

recipes.name: Chicken Nkwobi
recipes.description: Spiced chicken in thickened palm oil sauce

steps.instruction: Boil and shred chicken.
Dissolve potash in water.
Mix palm oil with potash water until thick.
Stir in chicken, crayfish, pepper, and utazi.

recipes.name: Doro Wat
recipes.description: Ethiopian-inspired spicy chicken stew served with rice

steps.instruction: Caramelize onions in niter kibbeh for 20 minutes.
Add berbere spice and tomato paste, stir well.
Add chicken and simmer until nearly done.
Add halved hard-boiled eggs and cook 5 more minutes.

recipes.name: Jollof Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken pieces cooked in jollof rice sauce

steps.instruction: Fry chicken pieces until golden.
Cook tomato blend with onion until oil separates.
Add rice, spices, and water.
Nestle chicken on top and cook until rice is done.

recipes.description: Chicken and rice one-pot from Francophone West Africa

steps.instruction: Season and brown chicken pieces.
Sauté onion and garlic, add tomato blend.
Add rice, water, and vegetables.
Add chicken on top, cover and cook until done.

recipes.name: Masa with Chicken
recipes.description: Fermented rice cakes served with shredded chicken

steps.instruction: Ferment rice flour batter overnight.
Boil and shred chicken with onion and ginger.
Cook masa cakes in a special pan.
Serve topped with shredded chicken.

recipes.name: Atama Soup
recipes.description: Palm leaf soup with chicken from southeastern Nigeria

steps.instruction: Boil chicken with onion until tender.
Add palm oil and potash dissolved in water.
Stir in shredded atama leaves and crayfish.
Simmer until soup thickens slightly.

recipes.name: Ofada Chicken
recipes.description: Local chicken in spicy ofada sauce

steps.instruction: Boil and season chicken.
Blend peppers.
Fry in palm oil.
Add chicken and simmer.

recipes.name: Fried Rice Nigerian
recipes.description: Stir-fried rice with vegetables and chicken

steps.instruction: Cook and cool rice.
Fry chicken and set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables.
Add rice, chicken, and soy sauce, toss together.

recipes.name: Pepper Chicken Special
recipes.description: Extra spicy chicken in scotch bonnet sauce

steps.instruction: Boil chicken.
Blend peppers.
Fry pepper blend.
Add chicken and simmer.

recipes.name: Jollof Spaghetti
recipes.description: Spaghetti cooked in jollof sauce with chicken

steps.instruction: Boil spaghetti until al dente.
Cook chicken.
Fry tomato blend.
Toss spaghetti in jollof sauce with chicken.

recipes.description: Spicy peppered snail in palm oil sauce

steps.instruction: Clean snails thoroughly with lime and salt.
Boil snails until tender.
Fry pepper blend in palm oil.
Toss snails in sauce and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Boboli Grilled Fish
recipes.description: Whole grilled fish with spicy pepper sauce

steps.instruction: Clean fish and score the sides.
Marinate with blended pepper, onion, thyme, and lemon.
Grill over medium coals, basting with oil.
Serve with extra pepper sauce.

recipes.name: Moi Moi

Whip air in; season; oil fold.
Pour into wraps/molds; steam 55 min set.

videos.videoTitle: Nigerian Moi Moi with Beans Flour | Flo Chinyere

recipes.name: Akara
recipes.description: Crisp bean fritters fried golden - street breakfast legend.

steps.instruction: Blend beans airy with peppers; whip hard.
Scoop rounds into 175°C oil.
Fry golden turning; drain paper.

videos.videoTitle: How to make Nigerian Akara in 2 ways for beginners | step by step

recipes.name: Asaro with Chicken (Yam Porridge)
recipes.description: Yam porridge with chicken, palm oil and peppers - hearty southwestern classic.

steps.instruction: Simmer yam with pepper blend + oil.
Mash some cubes for creamy body.
Greens wilt-in; adjust salt.

recipes.name: Ewa Agoyin
recipes.description: Mashed beans drowned in slow-fried agoyin pepper sauce.

ingredients.name: Agoyin sauce: bleached oil + dried pepper-onion-crayfish-free blend fried long

steps.instruction: Cook beans falling-apart soft.
Mash rough; spoon sauce over generously.

recipes.name: Nkwobi
recipes.description: Spiced cow foot in rich palm oil sauce served on a platter

steps.instruction: Boil cow foot with onion until very tender.
Dissolve potash in a little water.
Mix palm oil with potash water until it thickens.
Stir in cooked cow foot, crayfish, pepper, and utazi.

recipes.description: Fried plantain chunks with seasoned gizzard sauce

steps.instruction: Clean and boil gizzards until tender.
Season and deep-fry gizzards until crispy.
Cut plantain into cubes and fry golden.
Toss fried plantain with gizzards, onion, and pepper.

Boil water with pepper soup spice and onion.
Add fish steaks and cook gently for 10 minutes.
Add uziza and serve immediately.

recipes.description: Palm fruit soup with fresh fish

Add beletete, crayfish, and pepper.
Simmer gently so fish doesn't break.
Cook 15 minutes until oil floats on top.

recipes.name: Edikaikong
recipes.description: Mixed vegetable soup with waterleaf and pumpkin leaves

Heat palm oil and fry onion and locust beans.
Add waterleaf and cook down.
Add pumpkin leaves and crayfish, cook 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Pounded Yam
recipes.description: Smooth stretchy pounded yam served with soup

steps.instruction: Peel and cut yam into chunks.
Boil in water until very soft.
Drain and pound with a pestle until smooth.
Shape into smooth balls and serve with soup.

videos.videoTitle: how to make pounded yam in a food processor

recipes.description: Elastic starchy accompaniment made from cassava

steps.instruction: Mix cassava flour with water in a pot.
Stir continuously over heat until it forms a thick dough.
Knead with a wooden spoon until elastic.
Shape into balls and serve with soup.

recipes.name: Ofada Sauce
recipes.description: Spicy green pepper sauce for rice

steps.instruction: Blend green peppers and scotch bonnets.
Heat palm oil until smoking.
Add blended peppers and fry until reduced.
Stir in locust beans and cook 5 more minutes.

recipes.name: Asaro
recipes.description: Yam porridge mashed with tomato and palm oil

steps.instruction: Boil cubed yam until soft.
Blend tomatoes and fry in palm oil.
Add fried tomato to yam and mash together.
Season and cook until thick.

recipes.name: Vegetable Nkwobi
recipes.description: Spiced vegetable medley in thickened palm oil

steps.instruction: Slice garden eggs into rounds.
Dissolve potash in water.
Mix palm oil with potash water until thick.
Toss vegetables in sauce with crayfish and utazi.

recipes.name: Iwa Pepper Soup
recipes.description: Spicy catfish pepper soup with uziza

steps.instruction: Clean and slice catfish into steaks.
Boil pepper soup spice with water and onion.
Add fish and cook gently for 8 minutes.
Garnish with uziza leaves and serve.

recipes.name: Kokoro
recipes.description: Crunchy corn snack sticks from southwestern Nigeria

steps.instruction: Mix corn flour with ginger, sugar, and salt.
Add water to form a stiff dough.
Roll into thin sticks.
Deep-fry until crunchy and golden.

videos.videoTitle: HOW TO MAKE KOKORO SNACKS.  TRY  THIS RECIPE. No sugar mixed spices kokoro #kokoro #teammotso

recipes.name: Kuli Kuli
recipes.description: Crunchy groundnut cake fried without oil

steps.instruction: Grind groundnuts into a paste.
Season with ginger, pepper, and salt.
Squeeze out oil using a cloth.
Shape and fry the dry paste until crunchy.

recipes.name: Rice Water
recipes.description: Thin rice porridge served as a light breakfast

steps.instruction: Wash rice thoroughly.
Boil rice in plenty of water until very soft.
Mash slightly and let it become porridge-like.
Serve warm with milk and sugar.

recipes.name: Dodo Fried Plantain
recipes.description: Ripe plantain fried until caramelized golden

steps.instruction: Peel plantains and cut into diagonal slices.
Heat oil in a frying pan.
Fry plantain slices until golden on both sides.
Drain on paper towels and serve.

steps.instruction: Roast groundnuts until golden.
Melt sugar in a pan until caramelized.
Mix groundnuts with sugar, ginger, and pepper.
Spread on a greased surface and cut into bars.

recipes.name: Puff Puff

steps.instruction: Slack batter; rise 50 min bubbly.
Squeeze-round drops into 175°C oil.
Fry rolling till uniform brown; drain.

videos.videoTitle: Best Puff-Puff Recipe | Easy Nigerian Snack Tutorial (Step by Step)

recipes.name: Chin Chin
recipes.description: Crunchy sweet fried dough bites in endless jars.

steps.instruction: Knead firm sweet dough; rest 20.
Roll; cut small squares.
Fry batches golden; cool to crunch.

videos.videoTitle: How to make the Best Crunchy & Milky Chin Chin in Bulk. Very detailed and Beginner friendly

recipes.name: Mango Mousse
recipes.description: Light and airy mango cream dessert

steps.instruction: Bloom gelatin in water and melt.
Whip cream to soft peaks.
Fold mango pulp, sugar, and gelatin into cream.
Chill for 2 hours until set.

videos.videoTitle: Easy Mango Dessert | Mango Mousse Recipe

recipes.name: Chocolate Cake

steps.instruction: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time.
Fold in flour, cocoa, and baking powder alternately with milk.
Bake at 180C for 30 minutes.

videos.videoTitle: NIGERIAN CHOCOLATE CAKE RECIPE/FLUFFY AND YUMMY TO THE LAST BITE

recipes.name: Pawpaw Cream
recipes.description: Creamy chilled papaya dessert

steps.instruction: Scoop ripe pawpaw flesh into chunks.
Whip cream with sugar.
Fold pawpaw into cream.
Chill and serve with a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Coconut Candy
recipes.description: Sweet chewy coconut fudge

steps.instruction: Combine sugar and water in a heavy pan.
Cook until it reaches soft-ball stage.
Stir in grated coconut and vanilla.
Pour into greased tray and cut when cool.

recipes.name: Coconut Candy Sweet
recipes.description: Chewy coconut fudge pieces

steps.instruction: Cook sugar and water.
Add coconut and stir.
Pour into greased tray.
Cut when cool.

recipes.name: Fried Ice Cream

steps.instruction: Scoop ice cream and freeze hard.
Coat in flour, egg, then cornflakes.
Deep-fry 30 seconds.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Knock Knock Pastry
recipes.description: Flaky pastry filled with egg and spice

steps.instruction: Make pastry dough.
Fill with egg mixture.
Seal and shape.
Deep-fry until golden.

steps.instruction: Cook millet flour with water into a thick dough.
Knead with ginger and cloves into smooth balls.
Serve dissolved in cold fermented milk.
Add sugar to taste.

recipes.description: Smoky grilled chicken tossed in spicy pepper sauce - chicken version of Asun.

steps.instruction: Season chicken with thyme, bouillon and salt, grill over charcoal until 80% cooked.
Blend scotch bonnet, onion and bell pepper coarsely.
Heat oil, fry pepper blend 5 minutes until fragrant.
Toss grilled chicken in pepper sauce, smoke 5 more minutes and serve hot.
